purpose: Canonical registry of understood review defect classes and their durable cross-PR guards.

defects.guard: structural tests require both instruction surfaces to reference the canonical registry, mode marker, and preflight command without pinning explanatory prose
.hunter-preflight-mode is read from the checked-out branch head
only pytest exit 1 is accepted as intentional RED

defects.source: Issue #291 implementation hosted preflight failures and PR #293 stale-run acceptance on 2026-08-20
defects.guard_boundary: shared full preflight contract plus commit-scoped hosted evidence before review progression
defects.guard: agents run the canonical normal preflight before push and verify hosted evidence belongs to current HEAD
Mypy must pass in both normal and tests-first-red preflight

defects.source: Issue #291 pre-PR guard audit and PR #293 CodeRabbit/Codex reviews on 2026-08-20; PR #293 Codex P2 ADPR validator overreach on 2026-08-21
defects.guard_boundary: artifact-validator conformance to canonical protocol without false-positive merge blockers
defects.guard: artifact guards bind checks to the canonical semantic scope, accept equivalent valid formatting, and preserve escaped Markdown delimiters such as \| inside table cells; the architecture-readiness (ADPR) validator is scoped by the artifact's own canonical readiness claim rather than by repository path, because ARCHITECTURE_AUDIT_PROTOCOL.md limits its applicability to ADPR/readiness review and assigns implementation review to AI_REVIEW_PROTOCOL.md; the predicate is a disjunction over independent canonical readiness instruments (Governing protocol declaration, Final Verdict / Findings Matrix / Verdict Derivation headings, canonical verdict, canonical A-D finding record) so deleting one discriminator cannot evade validation, while non-readiness governed artifacts still receive protocol-independent baseline integrity validation

defects.source: Issue #291 pre-PR guard audit and PR #293 CodeRabbit on 2026-08-20
defects.guard_boundary: checkout step that prepares every shared-preflight job plus merge-base resolution
defects.guard: each shared-preflight job uses a preceding full-history checkout and changed-path detection fails closed without a proven origin/main merge-base

defects.source: PR #293 CodeRabbit hostile review and Codex recurrence reviews on 2026-08-20
defects.guard_boundary: rendered-Markdown-aware artifact parsing plus hostile representation fixtures
defects.guard: non-rendered fenced/commented/indented/raw-HTML content cannot impersonate audit semantics; raw pre/script/style/textarea blocks are masked including mixed case, attributes, multiline and unclosed-to-EOF forms
FULL audits require structured per-ADR accounting while TARGETED audits remain proportionally scoped

defects.source: PR #290 Codex/CodeRabbit and PR #293 Codex P1 on 2026-08-20
defects.guard: mandatory real headings cannot be empty where substantive scope/evidence/results/derivation/completion are required, Reviewed artifact identity is mandatory, and unresolved PENDING placeholders are rejected
reviewed revision is mandatory and mutable PR/Issue/URL evidence requires a valid offset-aware evidence cutoff
only explicit prior-review/previous-finding scope triggers re-verification, which then requires references with evidence/consequence or an explicit none declaration

defects.source: PR #290 and PR #293 CodeRabbit/Codex reviews on 2026-08-20; PR #293 Codex P1 duplicate-verdict recurrence on 2026-08-21
defects.guard_boundary: architecture-audit verdict section identity plus verdict, severity, and blocking semantics
defects.guard: one canonical verdict is derived bidirectionally from unresolved severity: A permits ready/minor, B rejects READY_FOR_ADR and permits minor/conditional, C requires ADPR_REVISION_REQUIRED, D requires ARCHITECTURE_NOT_READY; verdict section identity is counted independently of section content, so exactly one rendered level-two Final Verdict section may exist and a second identical or conflicting section cannot be ignored by section parsing that stops at the next heading; duplicate-looking verdict headings inside fenced, indented, commented, or raw-HTML literal regions do not count

defects.source: PR #290 CodeRabbit and PR #293 Codex P2 on 2026-08-20
defects.guard: finding records use canonical Severity A-D and the matrix uses Class; validation is scoped to actual finding records so unrelated Severity prose cannot create a false-positive blocker

defects.source: PR #293 Codex P1 reviews on 2026-08-20 and 2026-08-21
defects.guard_boundary: strict one-to-one architecture-audit finding record and matrix cross-validation
defects.guard: finding records and Findings Matrix rows are bidirectionally one-to-one by stable Finding ID: every rendered canonical record appears exactly once in the matrix and every matrix row maps to exactly one complete rendered record; duplicate record headings and duplicate matrix rows are rejected on cardinality rather than collapsed by a dict or set, so a rendered blocker cannot be omitted from the matrix and hidden from verdict derivation; record Severity and Blocks ADR must agree with the matrix
